name: cowork-usage-meter
description: Independent plugin, not an Anthropic product: shows context size and plan-limit use in the status line and warns at budgets you set.

conversationBudget.title: Per-conversation budget (points of the weekly limit)
conversationBudget.description: Warns at 80% and 100% of this. Approximate: limits are account-wide, so parallel conversations count too. The Chat figure excludes a conversation's first turn and the first turn after a long idle gap. 0 turns budget warnings off. To hide the Chat figure too, turn off its status-line segment.

fiveHourThresholds.title: Five-hour warning thresholds (%)
fiveHourThresholds.description: Comma-separated percentages of the five-hour limit; each warns once per crossing.

contextThreshold.title: Context-size threshold (tokens)
contextThreshold.description: Past this, suggests starting a fresh conversation with a handoff note.

cacheLifetimeMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheLifetimeMinutes.description: Idle time after which the next message is assumed to re-read the whole conversation at the full rate. Falls to 5 minutes while a plan window reads 100%.

coldCacheMinTokens.title: Cold-cache minimum size (tokens)
coldCacheMinTokens.description: Smaller conversations get no cold-cache warning.

showContext.title: Status line: context segment
showContext.description: Shows Ctx tokens and percentage of the window.

showChat.title: Status line: Chat segment
showChat.description: Shows the points of the weekly limit this conversation has used (approximate; excludes the first turn and the first turn after a long idle gap).
